newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola says new "Surge" drink is coming.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola says new "Surge" drink is coming.

text.p: Coca-Cola said Monday that Surge, a "Fully Loaded Citrus Soda," will appear on store shelves, vending machines and soft drink fountains across the U.S. beginning in mid-January 1997.

Created to appeal to youths and young adults, Surge has a citrus taste, low carbonation, a bright green color, and maltodextrin, an energy-yielding complex carbohydrate, a statement issued by Coca-Cola said.
Two television advertisements for the brand will air during Super Bowl XXXI on January 26, marking The Coca-Cola Company's first Super Bowl advertising since 1991, the statement said.

Marketing for Surge will include television, radio, and point-of-sale advertising, and sampling to more than 5,000,000 teens and young adults in the first month of the product's introduction, the statement said.
